messages:
Aaliya (Product PM): quick sync — planning SmartServe (predictive routing + cache-aware batching) for Q2 launch. Need cross-team owners and sequencing. main asks: enterprise customer wants Private + Dedicated fallback, SLA 99.9, and <200ms p95 for 512 tokens on hosted. who can own infra/capacity & security signoff?
Mike (Runtime): I can own runtime changes. estimate: 3w for predictive routing hooks + 2w for KV cache eviction + telemetry. need a thin API for routing hints. will depend on infra for extra nodes.
Nina (Infra): infra needs GPU quota increase (8x A100 equiv) for dedicated lanes and a rolling upgrade path for private clusters. ETA ~4w if prioritized. also need network config work for private control plane: ~2w.
Sam (Security): need data flow diagram and KMS plan for private deployment. HSM requirement adds procurement time. I can start review in parallel but gating: egress controls, audit log retention, key rotation.
Jasper (Eng Manager - Runtime): runtime suggests canary + auto-fallback to smaller model when latency spikes. runtime team needs 1 FTE for the 5w window to hit timeline.
Rachel (CS): customer will sign if we commit to reserved dedicated window and provide an ATO checklist for private. they want a beta by EoQ2 — realistic?
Aaliya (Product PM): realistic only if workstreams overlap. proposed sequence: security & infra start immediately (parallel), runtime builds routing + cache, then joint perf run and canary gating. tight but doable with infra prioritization.
Deepa (Eng-ML): predictive routing needs a tiny latency predictor model. can reuse embeddings; ~1wk prototype + 1wk integration. recommend 95th-percentile-aware batching logic to prevent latency cliffs.
Mike (Runtime): sample canary config we plan to use:
```
canary:
  pct: 10
  duration: 1h
  fallback: model-quantized-v2
  monitor: p95_latency, error_rate
```
we'll wire routing service to this.
Nina (Infra): concretely — if infra gets approval today we can provision dedicated pool + private control plane in ~18 business days. need PO for reserved nodes and log retention numbers to size storage.
Sam (Security): send me data flow diagram + endpoints list. will flag E2E test needs. HSM choice adds ~6w lead time.
Aaliya (Product PM): current owners: Product=Aaliya, Runtime=Mike/Jasper, Infra=Nina, Security=Sam, ML=Deepa, CS=Rachel. paste blockers + earliest unblock date pls.
Jasper (Eng Manager - Runtime): blocker: two infra APIs (quota, routing metadata). earliest unblock ~10 business days if infra prioritizes.
Nina (Infra): blocker: PO for reserved capacity + approvals for private control plane network changes. earliest unblock ~12 business days with approvals.
Sam (Security): blocker: HSM decision + legal signoff on data residency for private. worst-case unblock ~15 business days.
Deepa (Eng-ML): blocker: access to anonymized customer telemetry to train predictor. earliest unblock ~5 business days if CS provides dump.
Rachel (CS): I can get telemetry but need NDA amendments. I'll start today, expect materials in 4 business days.
Oliver (Product Director): constraint — do not jeopardize hosted SLOs. if dedicated/private launches leak capacity, throttle new signups. also need a pricing draft for dedicated lanes.
Aaliya (Product PM): action recap: Nina: start procurement + PO (12bd). Mike/Jasper: allocate 1 FTE for 5w window + implement canary hooks (10bd). Deepa: prototype predictor (5bd). Sam: security review & KMS/HSM decision (15bd). Rachel: telemetry + NDA (4bd). Checkpoint next Tue 9:30am PT. react with :thumbsup: if owners ok.
Mike (Runtime): :thumbsup:
Nina (Infra): :thumbsup:
Sam (Security): :thumbsup: pending diagrams
Jasper (Eng Manager - Runtime): :thumbsup:
Deepa (Eng-ML): :thumbsup:
Rachel (CS): :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy queued for canary namespace on staging at 2026-04-08T14:00Z (automated test run)
Aaliya (Product PM): thanks team — I'll post the invite and owner tracker link. ping here if anything changes.
